t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Choose options quickly as there is limited time, brown and purple start off as lucky for approximately 20 rounds then switch to being unlucky but switch back again. The colour of basket you have coincides with the gnome that you pick but the significance of this is unclear.

vb_textbox.text: The colour of basket you have corresponds with which forest you will enter. That is: the yellow basket is always in 1 forest and the red basket is always in the other. It would appear that at times the red basket/corresponding forest will yield more mushrooms but this can switch, meaning that the yellow basket/corresponding will be more successful - but pay attention as it can switch at any time! Certain gnomes represent the yellow basket and others represent the red basket. From what I can remember, the little yellow gnome, little orange gnome, little green gnome, big brown gnome and big blue gnome are all associated with the yellow basket. Therefore, most of the others are likely associated with the red basket. Good luck!
